To determine which developed countries have much lower BMI than the UK, we consider general comparative public health data regarding Body Mass Index (BMI) across developed nations. Studies frequently show that certain nations, notably France and Japan, have significantly lower average BMIs compared to the UK and the United States. 

Looking at the provided options:
(A) The United States has much lower BMI than the UK (False, US is higher)
(B) There are much lower BMIs in Canada and New Zealand (False, similar or higher)
(C) Australia (False)
(D) There are lower BMIs in America (False)
(E) Canada (False)
(F) The United States (False)
(G) France and Japan have lower BMI than the UK (True)

Final answer: G
